avis.texte: Ignore previous review on this, i had a reaction and thought it was from the 70 which ive been using awhile now, this is my 3rd purchase. Some say the ingredients changed, something does seem different but may just be me. Was actually an overuse of the peach niacinmide by Anua.

I spent most my life relying on just vitamin E oil because ALL moisturizers broke me out because i was just that sensitive and reactive but then i found the Heartleaf line which o originally started ordering from IHerb, and i thought wow!!! Finally something made for me, this is my 3rd time restocking and I am heartbroken! I even emailed Anua told them to never change their ingredients, ipdate packaging but leave ingredients alone that it was perfect as it was…oh we wont we stand by our line blah blah blah now, i look like I have chicken pox and red as blood! Ruined! Back to square 1.
I had to wash this product off immediately. It made me all splotchy and red and burn. I am still kind of red and splotchy the next day but I definitely will not be using again.
Amazing for the value, i have really senestive skin and i didnt break me out or flare up my rocsea. Very rich but not oily!
Idk i applied this cream and it instantly make me burn all over my face im not sure whats gonna happen i just washed it all off….

avis.titre: AMAZING! Glad I decided to try this cream
avis.texte: This cream is thick and hydrating, you can feel the "slip" and thickness of this product in a nice way. I use it before bed, I wouldn't use it during the day, probably too thick. But I'm a big fan of the heartleaf ingredient for redness from rosacea, and this cream is a winner.

avis.titre: This will be my go to moisturizer.
avis.texte: I was looking for a cheaper moisturizer for daily use. I have dry skin so I do apply this about three times a day it layers nicely and sits on the skin nicely. I got the oil cleanser duo free gift and I am obsessed with those! Highly recommended.
I am a redhead with very dry skin and this has vesn amazing in this cold weather we have been having. I've been using it nightly and my redness has calm down tremoundously.
